For grown-ups

Wonder Buddies is a free science game for Nigerian children aged 2 to 12, made to grow curiosity and a love of science.

Little Explorers (ages 2 to 4) uses pictures and sounds only, with no timers, scores or wrong-answer sounds. Leaving it needs a 3-second press by a grown-up, and it suggests a rest after 15 minutes. Science Arcade has nine worlds of quick games, each meeting a real scientist. School Science follows the revised national curriculum for Primary 1 to 6, term by term.

On this home screen, your child can tap the Sun, clouds, the tree, the river and more to hear short, checked science facts and fill their wonder jar. Primary 1 is open in School Science now, with lessons, practice, home activities, term badges and a printable certificate. More classes are coming.

Progress stays on this device; nothing is sent anywhere. Install the game as an app to keep progress safe. The Parent corner, with several children, voice messages and backups, is coming soon.

Developed by Dr. Arowolo Ayoola, Data-Lead Africa.
